title: Fixed entity-theme bundle Axis-C attribution at 114541 settled rows
hypothesis: With 114541 settled rows, versus 73275 at exp-20260729-006 and the frozen 109913 reopen bar, the unchanged six-query entity/theme news bundle may now show broad H10 replacement value versus cash, SPY, and QQQ; no query, ticker map, horizon, notional, threshold, response, ranking, sizing, exit, order, paper, or live behavior may change.

market_prior.provenance: Decision-time entry prices and same-notional cash, SPY, and QQQ next-open-to-H10 opportunity-cost comparators.

independent_evidence.provenance: Prospectively logged observer rows under the unchanged source manifest; current-cohort value fields remain inaccessible until start.

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The observable price prior treats the mapped equities as already reflecting public headlines, while the fixed relation bundle claims that incomplete transmission across private entities, policy, infrastructure, healthcare, and crypto resolves over ten sessions.

transmission.catalyst: A public headline matched by one of the six frozen entity/theme queries and joined to the fixed public-equity map before the next regular-session open.
transmission.expected_direction: Broadly positive replacement value versus cash, SPY, and QQQ, with at least four of six query groups positive versus both ETFs.
transmission.half_life: Exactly ten trading sessions from next regular-session open.

why_not_arbitraged: The surface is an attribution-only research observer with imperfect search-vintage provenance, heterogeneous headline relevance, repeated headlines, and coarse private-entity-to-public-equity mappings. Prior reads failed benchmark-relative breadth, and no capital is allocated.
falsifier: Reject unless the unchanged cohort has at least 250 settled rows and exactly six query groups; row means versus cash, SPY, and QQQ are all positive; all three row medians are nonnegative; observed-date means versus all three comparators are positive; at least four query groups are positive versus both SPY and QQQ; maximum positive-cash query share is at most 60%; and maximum positive-cash ticker share is at most 40%. Any failure rejects, with no slice or retune.

baseline.policy: Hold cash, SPY, or QQQ at the identical 4000 USD notional over each row's identical next-open-to-tenth-session-close window; retain current cash/no-new-entry behavior.

treatment.policy: Re-evaluate only the exact fixed source bundle on the newly matured settled cohort.

replacement_value_comparator: Same-notional, same-window cash, SPY, and QQQ holds for every row.

execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: Only already-settled rows with canonical OHLCV prices are read.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Gross fixed-4000-USD replacement-value diagnostics; no new cost assumption.
execution_envelope.borrow_dependency: None; no short or leveraged instrument.
execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: No capital is allocated; the probe cannot exceed settled ledger rows.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Observer first-seen precedes next-session-open entry; settlement ends at H10.

next_machine_action: Run outcome-blind D0-D3 through alpha_workflow qualify; only a unique hash-bound promotion may proceed to one start and one finish.
reopen_condition: If rejected, park this unchanged face until at least 171812 settled rows, a canonical PIT historical news archive, or a materially richer independent entity-relation/economic source; reset the builder threshold only after finish.

prediction.confidence_reason: The machine reopen bar is satisfied, but several prior unchanged-bundle reads failed broad benchmark-relative criteria.
